document.title: Answer of Corporate Energy Buyers Association in Support of Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc.'s et al. 08/03/2026 Motion for Abeyance

pages.text:
UNITED STATES OF AMERICA 
BEFORE THE 
FEDERAL ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION 
 
Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc., et al. 
) 
Docket No. EL26-70-000 
 
ANSWER OF CORPORATE ENERGY BUYERS ASSOCIATION  
IN SUPPORT OF THE MOTION FOR ABEYANCE 
 
Pursuant to Rule 213 of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission’s (Commission) 
Rules of Practice and Procedure,1 Corporate Energy Buyers Association (CEBA) respectfully 
submits this Answer in support of the motion for abeyance submitted jointly by Midcontinent 
Independent System Operator, Inc. (MISO) and MISO transmission owners (collectively, Joint 
Movants).2 Joint Movants ask the Commission to hold this proceeding in abeyance by 90 days 
and, in so doing, extend certain deadlines for responding to the June 18, 2026 Order to Show 
Cause (Show Cause Order).3 
The issues raised in the Show Cause Order raise complex and substantial issues that 
require due consideration to craft solutions that are appropriately tailored to the region. Granting 
the requested abeyance will promote administrative efficiencies by allowing time for MISO and 
stakeholders—including CEBA and its members—to work collaboratively, as opposed to a 
rushed proposal that would unnecessarily shift stakeholder debate to the Commission docket. 
Lastly, the requested abeyance strikes an appropriate balance: a 90-day extension would not 
materially impede the Commission’s objectives for advancing reforms quickly yet offers 
significant benefits in terms of enabling proposals to receive sufficient stakeholder feedback to 
 
1 18 C.F.R. § 385.213. 
2 Joint Movants August 3, 2026 Motion for Abeyance. 
3 Midcontinent Indep. Sys. Operator, Inc., 195 FERC ¶ 61,212 (2026).

2 
 
promote both commercial viability and legal durability of the proposals that MISO will file in 
mid-November. 
For these reasons, CEBA respectfully requests that the Commission grant the motion in 
an expedited manner. 
 
Respectfully submitted,
